headline: Every pack of gnocchi checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and visit to Mill Park
heroLede: Fresh pasta has a short use-by, and many shapes go into similar packs, so the seal, label and date have to be right every time. Here's what a camera check could look like on your packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every pack is sealed straight across, with no crease and no product caught in the seal. A weak seal on fresh pasta means it spoils before the use-by.
labelLede: A potato gnocchi and a pumpkin gnocchi pack can look much the same at line speed. The camera checks every pack carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: Fresh pasta has a short use-by window, so the date has to be right on every pack. The system reads the printed date and batch code and compares them with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Film offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.wrongCode: Wrong month: OCT printed, NOV expected
vocab.alert: Four creased seals in fifteen minutes on Line 1. Check the pack sealer.
